title: Mens: Nonlinear shrinkage estimation in nonparanormal models for financial applications
summary: We develop a theory of nonlinear shrinkage covariance estimation for nonparanormal (Gaussian-copula) models, in which each observed coordinate is an unknown strictly increasing transformation of a latent Gaussian vector. This model accommodates arbitrary marginal skewness and heavy marginal tails while retaining a Gaussian dependence structure, and it is the natural semiparametric setting for heavy-tailed, asymmetric financial returns.
